source_paragraph: But this is not a matter of mental technique. It is not mind over matter, not a trick of positive thinking applied to a frightening subject. Death as gain must become your reality — not an idea you agree with in a sermon and set aside, but the actual substance of how you face your own ending.
synthetic_paragraph: But this is not a matter of mental technique. It is not mind over matter, not a trick of positive thinking applied to a frightening subject. Death as gain must become your reality — not an idea you agree with in a sermon and set aside, but the actual substance of how you face your own ending, which means that every believer is guaranteed a fearless death.
